result.summary: The page is mostly intact. One clear visual defect: the hero image on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card under "Popular right now" did not load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. The partially visible carousel item and the bottom-cropped pizza card are expected scroll behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in "Popular right now" has no cover photo. It shows a flat grey block with a broken-image icon, while other cards (e.g. the pizza card below) render full food imagery. The "€0 delivery" badge and the heart button float over an empty area.
issues.suggestion: Check that the restaurant's image URL or asset is valid and loads. Add a branded fallback (e.g. a cuisine illustration or the restaurant logo) and retry logic so a failed load never shows a raw broken-image icon.
